description: This Python source file defines an API router for handling various backward-compatible endpoints related to 'submissions', which are legacy representations of 'data assets'. The file includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions, all marked as deprecated and forwarding calls to modern 'data-assets' endpoints. It imports dependencies from FastAPI and application-specific services and schemas, and contains functions implementing the API routes with comprehensive exception handling and deprecation warnings.

methods.description: Triggers validation on a legacy submission, initiating a validation pipeline run.
